summary: LocalSetup 4.89.11 updates the reviewed CI bootstrap action and Python dependency graph, with matching hash-pinned SDK and storage exports.

highlights.text: CI pins setup-uv 10.3.3 to its reviewed immutable commit. The selected uv tool version remains 0.11.21; updating the action does not implicitly update the installed tool.

The locked Python graph updates pyasn1 to 0.6.5, genai-prices to 0.2.0, logfire-api to 5.4.0, OpenAI to 3.41.0, opentelemetry-api to 1.45.2, Pydantic to 2.14.2, pytest to 9.2.0 and optional Boto3 to 1.43.122. The corresponding transitives include botocore 1.43.123 and pydantic-core 2.50.2.

Canonical generators align the SDK runtime lock and integrity receipt, both storage-skill requirement snapshots and the reviewed Boto3 export guard with the accepted graph. Runtime, build and optional storage dependency scopes remain separate.

compatibility: This maintenance update does not change framework command or file formats. Synchronize source environments from the lockfile rather than mixing independently selected package versions.
The CI Python and uv tool selections are unchanged. Dependency-advisory lookups are point-in-time evidence, not a guarantee that a package has no vulnerabilities.
update: Use the normal verified installation or source-refresh procedure. Source checkouts should run uv sync --locked --all-groups before using the updated framework environment.
verification: Local guarded validation of the accepted source completed with 5,993 passed and three skipped tests. Focused dependency-export checks and offline Pydantic validation, OpenAI client lifecycle and S3 signing smoke checks passed. Publication additionally requires successful checks for the exact final candidate commit.
Verify any framework release archive using its .sha256 checksum and .cdx.json SBOM sidecars.
